messages: Mia: Quick convo: Do we standardize 'required' indicators or vary by surface? thinking dense tables vs full forms + destructive confirms (typed-confirm vs modal+undo). cc @Sam @Jordan Sam: Surface-adaptive. Dense: minimal (mark optional only). Full forms: explicit 'Required' badge. reduces clutter and answers "do I need this?" Jordan: Accessibility: visual markers must have programmatic hooks. aria-required + sr-only text so screen readers get the meaning. e.g. `` Ana: Error behaviour: inline error per field for immediacy. For long flows (>6 fields) add an error summary at top linking to each invalid control. Focus first invalid when summary item clicked. Kevin: Destructive pattern: typed-confirm only for irreversible org-level actions. For item deletes use modal + undo toast. On mobile avoid typed-confirm; use checkbox + confirm CTA + undo. Also consider rate limits: if user deletes many items quickly, surface a stronger confirmation. Priya: Copy notes: keep badge text short: 'Required'. Error copy should lead with the problem then the fix: 'Password too short. Use 10+ characters.' Mia: Action items: design two mocks: (1) compact list/table with optional-only markers, (2) full form with required-pill + inline errors + top summary. Kevin to prototype destructive flow patterns and mobile fallback. Sam: I'll make the compact mock and a small CSS token for the pill. Kevin: I'll prototype destructive flows including keyboard and screen-reader notes and an undo spec (6s dismiss). Jordan: I'll draft the a11y checklist for the docs. Ana: I'll wire the full-form mock with error anchors. Priya: I'll post microcopy options to the ticket. Mia: Thanks everyone 44d I'll create the ticket and link mocks. Aim to finalize this sprint.
